title: A control that removes itself when activated must move focus to what replaces it
rule: When activating a button changes state so a `v-if` removes that button (stop, remove, ×, a chip that turns back into its 'add' form), move focus after `nextTick` to the control that replaces it, or to the nearest stable control, when `document.activeElement` is body. A watcher on some other state (for example an overlay's `open`) does not cover this path. Test it: focus the button, activate it, assert `document.activeElement` is the replacement.
rationale: E50.9 (#580): 'stop' in the glyph popover and the compare chip's × unmounted themselves; focus fell to body, so Escape no longer closed the popover and Tab restarted at the top.
